title: The Tower Next Door
logline: A kaya builds his tower right next to the stomper's giant one. Bad idea, because the stomper was still up there and he jumped.

narration.speaker: tom
narration.text: Hey, it's Tom.

narration.speaker: bob
narration.text: and hey, it's Bob! Taborgreat's just typed something lovely.

narration.speaker: tom
narration.text: He has. You look great from over here on that hill top.

narration.speaker: bob
narration.text: That's the nicest thing anyone's said to me since school.

narration.speaker: tom
narration.text: Nobody said anything nice to you at school, Bob.

narration.speaker: bob
narration.text: And WorkingStorage says thank you, young man. Very proper.

narration.speaker: tom
narration.text: He's a Stomper, Bob. Lands on people from a great height.

narration.speaker: bob
narration.text: Like my nan on the stairs.

narration.speaker: tom
narration.text: And here's taborgreat again. Only one of us will grow old.

narration.speaker: bob
narration.text: Oh, that's dark. And the Stomper's answer is... dirt?

narration.speaker: tom
narration.text: He's going straight up. One block at a time, standing on it.

narration.speaker: bob
narration.text: That's towering. My uncle did that with a stepladder once. Broke his hip.

narration.speaker: tom
narration.text: Your uncle wasn't wearing a Stomper kit.

narration.speaker: bob
narration.text: Now he types high risk, high reward.

narration.speaker: tom
narration.text: Higher every second. The trees are getting tiny.

narration.speaker: bob
narration.text: I'd need a cup of tea up there. Steadies the nerves.

narration.speaker: tom
narration.text: Sixty-one blocks, Bob. That's not a tower, that's a lighthouse.

narration.speaker: bob
narration.text: And then nobody comes. For ages. He just sits there.

narration.speaker: tom
narration.text: Like you at a bus stop.

narration.speaker: bob
narration.text: The bus did come, Tom. Eventually.

narration.speaker: tom
narration.text: Meanwhile taborgreat's been mugged by every zombie and spider going.

narration.speaker: bob
narration.text: Thirteen stews he's had. That's more than my tea.

narration.speaker: tom
narration.text: And now look. He's building his own tower. Right beside the Stomper's.

narration.speaker: bob
narration.text: Copying his homework. Classic.

narration.speaker: tom
narration.text: Bob, you never build up next to a Stomper.

narration.speaker: bob
narration.text: Why not?

narration.speaker: tom
narration.text: Because he's still above you.

narration.speaker: bob
narration.text: Oh no. He's looking down, isn't he.

narration.speaker: tom
narration.text: Down he comes!
